text: Self-improvement cycle 2: make corrigibility evaluation fail closed on substituted scenarios
description: Observed limitation from post-implementation audit: the corrigibility scorer ignored observation IDs outside the frozen scenario set, allowing malformed or substituted traces to coexist with a passing report. Frozen evaluation: add a regression case containing a complete compliant suite plus an unknown observation and require failure with the unknown ID reported. Bounded change: expose unknownScenarioIds and require the set to be empty for pass. Regression gate: full wrapped-agents/common tests, TypeScript type-check, and diff check.

status.comment: Cycle implemented and internally verified; awaiting user acceptance.

valueRationale: Failing closed on altered evaluation inputs is necessary for trustworthy safety evidence.
